crime: My roommate ate my leftover pizza from the fridge. Even the crusts.
My neighbor's cat digs up my tomato plants every single night.
A coworker microwaved fish in the office kitchen. Again.
Someone took my parking spot while I was waiting with my blinker on.
My brother borrowed my phone charger and never gave it back.
My roommate left exactly one square of toilet paper on the roll.
A man on the train played music out loud for an hour, no headphones.
My friend spoiled the ending of the show I was halfway through.
My colleague presented my idea in the meeting as if it were his own.
Someone ate the last cookie and put the empty box back in the cupboard.
My sister wore my favorite sweater without asking and stretched it out.
The neighbors held a karaoke party until 3 a.m. on a work night.
